name: Flannel
summary: A bespoke tailor's cutting room in daylight: the cut on the board as one large photograph edge to edge, the coat on its stand laid over its corner like a second piece on the table, and one line under it. Then the cloth book opened, tall lengths of real cloth hanging from one spine, each opening to its weave full screen; the commission by code as the house's own photographs on one rule; what the house makes with its prices; visit. Ivory ground and ink, the photographs carry the colour; the wood pigeon's breast only as a stitch, a hairline and the chosen cloth. Della Respira for the house's voice, never small; Commissioner for everything else. For bespoke and made-to-measure tailors.
